messages:
nora: Quick async — status update for the cache-priming lane (kernel + batching). Wanted to consolidate owners/blockers and next milestones.

sam: Thanks — can you call out what changed vs last week?

nora: Main change was batch coalescing in the kernel path + an aggressive cold-start cache-priming pass. PRs: #3427 (coalescing) and #3490 (priming job). Canary started last night.

jess: Observed a tiny tail increase on g4x canary during a few 99.9 spikes — reproducible in one traffic shard. Not consistent across regions.

lee: I ran the tail trace, looks like extra lock contention inside the new coalesce loop. Stack sample: `runtime_kernel::coalesce_inner -> kv::fetch_prefix -> lock::shard_local` — adding small sleep hides it.

mike: Repro steps I used: `stress-gen --seq=8 --concurrency=48 --prefetch=true`. I can re-run with profiling on Monday if we want more samples.

nora: Action items: 1) lee to try non-blocking prefetch path (owner). 2) sam to revert coalesce flag for g4x canary if we see >1.5% tail regression (owner). 3) jess to run wider canary on us-west-2 with longer windows (owner). Target checkpoint: EOD Tuesday.

lee: picking up non-blocking prefetch prototype today. If it looks stable I'll open a small PR with fallback.

sam: I'll add a temporary canary gating rule: if p99 increases by >1.5% over baseline for 15m, auto-disable the new coalesce flag.

jess: Added a canary run that scales to 3 shards; will post results here when done.

nora: Also a small config suggestion from infra: lower `coalesce_window_ms` to 2 for g4x to reduce contention spikes. Example we tried:
```
batching:
  max_delay_ms: 8
  coalesce_window_ms: 2
  allow_priming: true
```

mike: FYI I saw one CI flake on unit test runtime/queue.rs after the priming change — linked in PR CI logs. Looks like timing sensitive test.

lee: I'll stabilize that test and push a fix. Likely we need to mock time in the unit.

nora: Dependencies: infra needs to approve the canary scaling (sam is owner), and QA to run the regression harness. If anyone has bandwidth to boot the harness, ping me.

sam: I'm on it for infra approval today.

deploy-bot: Canary: runtime-service@g4x-us-west-2 - batch-coalesce + priming - started 2026-03-02T03:45:00Z

jess: Canary results (summary): 12h run, p99 up 0.9% overall but one shard hit 2.3% for ~7 minutes. Heap stable. No errors.

nora: Okay — plan: lee tries non-blocking prefetch PR by Monday AM; mike will fix test; sam holds the canary gate and will revert if we cross 1.5% again; jess runs extended 24h shard test after PR lands.

mike: ETA on test fix: Monday lunchtime.

lee: ETA non-blocking PR: Monday EOD if no unexpected regressions.

nora: Next milestone: merge PRs + pass 24h extended canary => target Wed EOD for rollout bump. If anything changes I’ll post an update here.

sam: noted, will watch the gate. :eyes:

jess: tagging @mike for the unit flake follow-up once you have a draft.

mike: will do.

nora: Thanks all — ping here for any urgent rollbacks or logs.
